source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP_CRPS1~TEMP_CRPS2 should get pass result.

original_test_intent: Subject to engineer acceptance of the localized Criteria correction, independently exercise every applicable TEMP_PSU1 through TEMP_PSU6 channel across approved warning and critical transitions, verify per-PSU SDR and SEL behavior plus power-system protection, and prove recovery.
original_method: An engineer heats the target power-supply sensor while IPMI observes readings and thresholds. The Items and test name consistently say PSU1~6, but preserved Criterion 5 says CRPS1~2 and therefore cannot be used unchanged as the execution acceptance matrix.
manual_activity: An engineer confirms that the acceptance target is the six-PSU Items set, maps each installed module and its safe stimulus path, approves the redundancy and recovery envelope, operates any physical/environmental equipment and retains emergency power authority.
required_inputs: Approved correction stating that each applicable TEMP_PSU1 through TEMP_PSU6 must pass independently, or an explicit different engineer decision
PSU model/serial/firmware, bay, AC feed, sensor, SDR and actual-population/applicability map for all six positions
rated and measured input/output voltage, current and power, load-share tolerance, redundancy policy and headroom
PMBus or supported vendor read-only status, fan and fault telemetry for each PSU
per-channel thresholds, hysteresis, SEL data, derating/fault/shutdown expectation and Project Expected Result
approved load/environmental stimulus, per-PSU thermal coupling, ramp/dwell/maximum/abort/cooldown and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not execute the dynamic test until an engineer accepts the PSU1~6 criteria correction; preserve the contradictory Master wording as source evidence.
Do not unplug AC, hot-swap a PSU, force load-share settings, rewrite thresholds or use power-state changes as a substitute for the stated heat stimulus.
Before loading or heating, prove adequate power headroom and the approved redundancy mode; continuously monitor all output rails, module power, load share, fans, PMBus/status, host and BMC.
Abort on derating, rail instability, over-current/voltage fault, redundancy loss, unexpected shutdown, thermal overshoot or loss of telemetry.
Preserve the first PSU-specific SEL, PMBus, rail and console evidence; do not clear it or auto-retry.
Remove the stimulus or load, restore nominal cooling and verify every applicable PSU, rails, load share, redundancy, host and BMC recover before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, bind every sample to exact PSU serial, bay, AC feed, sensor and SDR identity and record non-populated positions explicitly.

Run only an engineer-approved load profile or monitor engineer-operated environmental equipment while collecting synchronized per-PSU temperature, fan, input/output power, PMBus/status, SEL, rail, redundancy and host evidence.
Produce separate warning/critical assert, deassert and recovery results for each applicable PSU1 through PSU6; a subset, one hotter module or CRPS1~2 evidence cannot satisfy the six-position matrix.
Do not accept the Master typo on the engineer's behalf, apply physical heat, alter power topology, clear evidence, auto-retry or issue the DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Accept or reject the proposed Criterion 5 correction and define the authoritative power-module scope without modifying the preserved Master source.
Approve the six-position applicability map, redundancy/headroom, thermal or load plan, limits/events and recovery; operate the physical setup.
Assess any power-quality, protection or redundancy anomaly and issue per-PSU and overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR and sensor lists are baseline-only, expose a password and disable host verification, do not retrieve SEL, and cannot create, attribute or recover six independent thermal transitions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an approved authenticated OOB IPMI/SEL path plus per-PSU PMBus or vendor read-only telemetry, calibrated probes and rail/load-share monitoring during the approved stimulus; keep credentials out of command text and preserve host verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact PSU1~6 Items, contradictory CRPS1~2 criterion, high-level IPMI commands, script and 5/10-minute values remain unchanged; Project SPEC supplies actual dwell and safe access.

modernized_recommendation.status: ENGINEER CRITERIA ACCEPTANCE AND PROJECT SIX-PSU PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Accept a PSU1~6 checkpoint matrix, map every installed module, baseline load share and redundancy, apply a bounded per-PSU-coupled thermal or load condition, correlate each threshold with SEL and protection behavior, then unload/cool and prove recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, installed PSU population, AC-feed architecture, PSU model/firmware, load-share policy and airflow design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU model/serial/firmware, BMC/SDR, PMBus or vendor interface, load equipment and probe versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project power topology plus vendor PSU thermal, derating, PMBus/status, load-share, redundancy and recovery specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects only the suggested acceptance checkpoint in the Review layer, adds immutable six-module identity and measured power/recovery evidence, and leaves every Master field untouched.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static visibility, CRPS1~2 evidence or any PSU subset is partial only and cannot establish all applicable PSU1~6 threshold paths.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Engineer criteria acceptance, six-module map, load/redundancy baseline, qualified stimulus, limit/event matrix and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Shared system load and airflow may heat modules unevenly; one PSU may derate and remove redundancy before the BMC threshold sequence completes.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define fewer populated positions or a different approved load, chamber or ducted-air method, but must document applicability, actual per-PSU coupling, equivalent coverage and any unexercised path. It cannot silently replace the six-PSU target with CRPS1~2 or claim unpopulated/untested modules passed.
expected_evidence: Preserved Master row plus dated engineer acceptance or rejection of the proposed PSU1~6 Criteria correction
PSU1~6 population, model/serial/firmware/bay/AC-feed/sensor/SDR identity and applicability matrix
rated/measured input-output-load-share, redundancy/headroom and PMBus/status baseline
approved stimulus profile, calibrated probes, per-module coupling and abort record
timestamped per-PSU temperature/fan/power, decoded warning/critical assert/deassert SEL, PMBus faults, rails, redundancy and host/BMC state
stimulus removal/cooldown, recovered load share/redundancy/rails/host/BMC health and engineer per-PSU plus overall verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The test name, Items and DeepSeek output target TEMP_PSU1~6, while preserved Criterion 5 names TEMP_CRPS1~TEMP_CRPS2. This is a direct internal acceptance-scope conflict. In addition, code Wistron-BMC-00078-V003 is reused at row 1510 for unrelated immediate power-off; row 788 remains independent by physical identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The surrounding title, Items and procedure make the six-PSU thermal purpose sufficiently identifiable for review, while the localized copied criterion must be explicitly accepted by an engineer before execution. The correction decision, installed population, thresholds and safe stimulus are readiness inputs, so the case is not permanently BLOCKED under ED-36.

review_improvement: Preserves the Master typo as evidence, proposes an auditable PSU1~6 correction without overwriting source, and makes every applicable PSU plus shared power-system behavior independently accountable.
independent_technical_reasoning: TEMP_PSU1~6 denotes six potentially distinct modules or channels whose readings, events and recovery must be tied to immutable physical identities. The CRPS1~2 phrase is inconsistent with the row's title and Items and is best handled as an engineer-approved Review-layer correction, not as permission for AI to pick targets or as permanent blockage. Physical stimulus and emergency response remain engineer-owned; synchronized telemetry is automatable after approval.
